verdict.rationale: The SDKs are documented as sharing a common consent model (amplitude-docs-16), and Session Replay claims to 'honor consent, and control what gets captured' (amplitude-docs-33). This implies tracking can be gated on consent, but no explicit opt-out mechanism is described, and nothing addresses opting out of telemetry from Amplitude's own tools such as the Wizard CLI or MCP server. Missing for 10: a documented opt-out API or flag, opt-out of first-party telemetry in the CLI and MCP tooling, detailed docs on how opt-out works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
